actions.action: Enforce format eligibility on the server
actions.mechanism: Creation requires the flag and declared write capabilities; opening requires the document's declared read capabilities.
actions.implementation: Persist required capabilities per document. Check authorization and capabilities on create, open, and edit; reject unsupported requests before returning document payloads.
actions.check: Exercise flag-on/off requests from both binaries. Old clients still open legacy documents but cannot create or receive unsupported formats.
actions.risk: Declared capabilities do not prove parser correctness.

actions.action: Fork upgrades without replacing readable originals
actions.mechanism: Separate document identities preserve old clients' access without pretending a legacy snapshot represents newer content.
actions.implementation: Prohibit in-place legacy upgrades. Create an explicitly labeled new-format fork, preserving the original's content, permissions, and discoverability. Do not automatically merge unsupported edits back.
actions.check: During mixed-version collaboration, an old client reads and edits the original while a new client edits the fork; neither overwrites the other.
actions.risk: Branches diverge and require explicit reconciliation.

actions.action: Make rollback stop creation, not erase documents
actions.mechanism: Separate rollout admission from durable format support so existing new documents survive flag reversal.
actions.implementation: On rollback, reject new-format creation and upgrades. Preserve existing bytes and metadata; retain compatible read handlers and make existing new documents explicitly read-only.
actions.check: Create and edit a new document, disable the flag, then verify identical content, compatible-client reopening, and rejected writes without deletion.
actions.risk: Removing format handlers during deployment rollback would break access.

actions.action: Bind capability decisions to each client session
actions.mechanism: Prevent a newer device's cached capabilities from authorizing unsupported payloads for an older device on the same account.
actions.implementation: Bind capability declarations to sessions and revisions. Key cached decisions by session, capability revision, document format, and policy epoch; revalidate mismatches before serving content.
actions.check: Seed an old session with a newer session's cached allowance. Verify rejection of new-format payloads while legacy reads remain available.
actions.risk: Incorrect declarations within the same session remain undetectable.
